features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.desc: You gain proficiency with Smith's Tools, and you learn to speak, read, and write Giant.

features.name: Rune Carver
features.desc: You learn runes (2 at level 3, up to 5 at level 15) and inscribe them on your gear during a rest. Runes grant passive benefits and an activated effect (as a Reaction or Bonus Action).

features.name: Giant's Might
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you become Large for 1 minute, have Advantage on Strength checks and saving throws, and once per turn deal extra damage (1d6/1d8/1d10). Number of uses equals your Proficiency Bonus.

features.name: Runic Shield
features.desc: As a Reaction, you force a creature attacking an ally within 60 feet to reroll the d20 (a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus).

features.name: Great Stature
features.desc: You grow 3d4 inches taller; the extra damage from Giant's Might increases to 1d8.

features.name: Master of Runes
features.desc: You can invoke each rune you know twice, regaining its invocations on a rest.

features.name: Runic Juggernaut
features.desc: The extra damage from Giant's Might increases to 1d10; when you use it, you can become Huge, increasing your reach by 5 feet.
